prompt: Create a scenic, high quality, high definition fishing game. People start on a small beach and have to earn enough money from fishing every round to get the keys to the boat. Then they can boat to the next island. Repeat this for 3 islands

ledger.means: Players fish: cast, a bite, a catch

ledger.words: People start on a small beach
ledger.means: Each game starts on a small beach

ledger.words: earn enough money from fishing every round to get the keys to the boat
ledger.means: Catches earn money; enough of it in a round gets the boat's keys

ledger.words: Then they can boat to the next island
ledger.means: With the keys, players take the boat to the next island
Three islands in a row, each its own place
Several people play the same game together

ledger.words: a scenic, high quality, high definition

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
